title: agents-cli agents.yaml
description: agents-cli metadata file. Two tiers share this shape: the central (synced) ~/.agents/agents.yaml and each per-device ~/.agents/devices/<host>/agents.yaml. Device-local fields (agents, isolatedAgents, routines) belong in the device doc; device-scope operator config lives centrally under fleet.devices.<name>.config (`agents devices config <name>`); everything else is portable user config. Source of truth: apps/cli/src/lib/types.ts (Meta).

agents.description: Per-device global version pins (agent id → version). Device doc only.

isolatedAgents.description: Per-device preferred isolated version per agent. Device doc only.

defaultBrowserProfile.description: Browser profile `agents browser start` resolves to without --profile. Superseded: now this machine's browser.profile key in the central fleet.devices.<name>.config block (`agents devices config <name> browser.profile <profile>`).

routines.description: Enabled routine names on this device. Membership means enabled; device doc only.

config.description: Typed user-scope config keys (registry: apps/cli/src/lib/device-config.ts). Device-scope keys (maxAgents, schedulerEnabled, notes, ssh*, autoLaunch*) live in the central fleet.devices.<name>.config block instead — see the fleet property. Unset keys keep default behavior.

interactiveHost.description: User scope. Device that shows the user artifacts (browser opens, dashboards). Set via `agents devices config <name> interactive.host <name>`.

autoPool.description: User scope. Which devices automatic placement (`--device auto`) may pick: 'workers' (default — only devices marked role=worker, once any is marked) or 'all'. A device marked personal is never picked under either mode. Set via `agents config set auto.pool <mode>`.

secrets.description: macOS secrets-agent defaults (backend, prompt policy, hold window).

budget.description: Spend guardrails (user-global caps; project agents.yaml overrides).

registries.description: Resource registries by type (commands, skills, hooks, mcp, …).

profiles.description: Top-level resource profiles filtering the resolved resource set.

versions.description: Per-version resource tracking. Machine-local — partitioned to ~/.agents/.history/version-resources.json on write.

source.description: Git remote source URL of the system repo.

actors.description: Actors keyed by slug — who is behind a run.

seededPresets.description: Removal tombstones for seeded registry presets.

hooks.description: Hook manifest entries keyed by hook name.

browser.description: Browser profile definitions keyed by profile name (portable; syncs).

hosts.description: Agent-host registry (`agents hosts`) keyed by host name.

fleet.description: Declarative fleet profile (`agents apply`). Shape: lib/fleet/types.ts FleetManifest. `fleet.devices.<name>.config` is also the central store for per-device operator config (`agents devices config <name>`) — names and non-secret values only.

devices.description: The string 'all', or a map of device name → override. Each override's `config` holds the device-scope keys of the device-config registry (`agents devices config <name> <key> <value>`).

config.description: Device-scope operator config for this device (central, synced). Unset keys keep default behavior.

role.description: What this device is for, fleet-wide (`agents devices role <name> <role>`). Marking any device 'worker' makes `--device auto` an allowlist over the marked workers; a 'personal' device is never picked automatically. A paired cockpit's 'control' role lives in that box's own device registry (agents devices pair-ios), not here.

maxAgents.description: Cap on concurrent agents (agents.max-concurrent). AGI EXT auto-launch counts device-wide running agents; teams placement counts the team's roster on the device.

schedulerEnabled.description: Whether the routines scheduler may fire here (scheduler.enabled).

daemonEnabled.description: Top-level kill switch: whether the daemon may run on this device at all (daemon.enabled).

watchdogEnabled.description: Whether the daemon runs the watchdog pass on this device (watchdog.enabled).

browserRemoteControl.description: Whether other fleet machines may drive THIS device's browser (browser.remote-control). Default off.

defaultBrowserProfile.description: Browser profile `agents browser start` resolves to without --profile on this device (browser.profile).

browserTaskIdleMinutes.description: Minutes a browser task may sit with no IPC action before the daemon's abandoned-task reaper closes its tabs (browser.task-idle-minutes). Default 30; 0 disables idle reaping (a task whose owning agent session exited is still closed).

notes.description: Free-form operator notes (`agents devices config <name> notes <text>` appends one).

sshUser.description: SSH login user (ssh.user) — overrides the registry profile's user at dial time.

sshAuth.description: SSH auth method (ssh.auth): key (agent/on-disk keys) or password (from a secrets bundle).

sshBundle.description: Secrets bundle holding the SSH password (ssh.bundle). A bundle NAME — never a secret value.

sshBundleKey.description: Key within the bundle whose value is the password (ssh.bundle-key; default 'password').

sshIdentityFile.description: Explicit private-key path for key auth (ssh.identity-file; passed to OpenSSH with IdentitiesOnly=yes).

platform.description: OS family of the device (platform) — picks PowerShell vs POSIX remotely. Overrides the discovered platform.

autoLaunchEnabled.description: Whether AGI EXT auto-launch may pick this device (auto-launch.enabled; default on).

autoLaunchPreferred.description: Boost this device in AGI EXT auto-launch ranking (auto-launch.preferred; default off).

discovery.description: Portable device discovery decisions. Approved devices are registered when reachable; ignored devices remain hidden on every machine after user-repo sync.

notify.description: Owner/channel notification config for `agents send` / `agents notify`.

projects.description: Allowlist of project roots whose .agents/routines may fire.
